marketing_description: The JET JT9-714400K Bandsaw features a 13 in cutting capacity, 116 in steel blade, and variable speed setting. It is powered by a 1.3 kW motor and has a 1-3/4 hp rating, with a 7-1/2 to 15 A amperage rating. The bandsaw has a 14 in blade wheel diameter and a 21 x 17 in table size.
